name: get_oncall_schedule
description: get_oncall_schedule: Retrieve an employee's current on-call registrations for a given unit. Returns existing registrations so any scheduling conflicts can be identified.

employee_id.description: The employee's ID. Format: EMP followed by 6 digits. Example: EMP048271

unit_code.description: The unit to check. Format: digits+letter-letters. Example: 4B-ICU
